sleeve-attached drawings: their own sleeve/cuff masked and matte halo removed

pending or rejected drawings are listed but not approved; production use requires approval

walking.why: relaxed or partially closed hands; no pointing or thumbs-up while walking

running.why: loose fists or relaxed hands, the same on both arms, no wrist twist

pointing.why: pointing hand, index toward the target (arm IK reaches, the wrist aims)

shrugging.why: expressive shrug: palms up (an open palm-up drawing; a cupped palm-up drawing as an approximation)

shrug_subtle.why: subtle shrug: hands low, palms turned toward the camera or edge-on

explaining.why: open or cupped hands, varied between beats

hand_on_desk.why: hand resting on the desk top: palm down (seen from above) preferred

angry.why: fists; pointing only when the action has a target

gripping.why: grip hand on the interaction target

thumbs_up.why: thumbs-up, thumb turned to read upward

hand_on_hip.why: relaxed or cupped hands on the hips, no extreme rotation

rules.resolution: explicit user choice > switch keyframe > this engine (auto mode only) > group default
hard_constraints: approval (production: approved + original only; review: + pending)
rotation from the drawn orientation <= the drawing's tolerance
rules.disclaimer: scores rank the drawings the character has for an action; they do not measure visual quality

selection.note: the selection algorithm runs in AutoRig; Moho would receive its results as switch keys

moho_mapping.proposal: one Moho Switch Layer per group (child per variant image), bound to the hand bone; switch keys from 'keyframes'; live actions map to switch values later

not_implemented_in_native_moho: creating a Switch layer and adding these images as its children: no Moho API for it is verified in the allowlist
binding switch values to Smart Bones, actions or Live Mode inputs (input identifiers not discovered)
writing a .moho/.mohoproj file: blocked until the Phase 0 importer is verified natively
